duration.text: The Tourism management at Taizhou University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: (1)Scanned copy of passport front page;(2)Scanned copies of high school graduationcertificate and transcript or equivalent educationalcertificate and transcript. Master's students arerequired to provide their undergraduate graduationcertificate andtranscript;(3)Scanned copies of physical examination reportsissued bydesignated medical institutions ordesignated hospitals in Taizhou City outside thecountry (territory) by the Chinese government;(4)Scanned copies of Chinese Proficiency Test (HSK)score level certificate and/or English Proficiency Test(IELTS, TOEFL) certificate;(5)Scanned copyof $3000 economic guaranteecertificate;(6)1-2 scanned copies of recommendation letters;(7) Certificate of no criminal record;(8) One electronic photo.

requirements.text: (1)Foreign citizens holding foreign passports;(2) The physical health condition meets the physical examination requirements stipulated bythe country and our school;(3) Age not exceeding 45 years old.(4)Having a bachelor's degree or equivalent education;(5) Non native English speaking applicants must achieve an English proficiency level of IELTS6.0 or TOEFL 75. Applicants without an English proficiency certificate are required to providea 3-minute English language video;(6)Students are required to undergo an interview organized by the school during theapplication process (which can be done remotely).
